detail.longDescription: Running autonomous personal agents locally on your own hardware without cloud lock-in is quickly gaining momentum. simplexai-labs/linger is trending on GitHub—an open-source personal agent designed to run completely on your PC through efficient model and harness co-design, keeping data and compute local on everyday machines. https:// github.com/simplexai-labs/ling er # OpenSource # LocalAI # Linux # AIAgents # Privacy # GitHub
